filter FieldOutsideParts by PartsKind; collect UniqueID values in source row order; choose floor(draw_u32*N/2^32); zero candidates return 0 without selection
fill perimeter cells with OutsideSea parts chosen by ReefType compatibility, including four corner transitions
clear the 5x4 interior coordinates after perimeter assembly
orchestrate zero -> slots; when temporary header bit 0 is set, fill sea ring -> clear interior -> copy 0x90-byte grid
selected template setup copies an enable field, builds the coast grid, then writes it to the resource object
convert 72 u16 grid entries into 72 0x18-byte records
native_pipeline.spatial_units: integer grid indices only; world scale/rotation/translation remain unresolved
